[center][b]This mod is no longer SUPPORTED, if you would like to contribute or use any assets you are welcome to just be sure to credit ;)[/b]

Seasonal Anime Portraits III is a [CP] standalone scripted mod that gives Villager a different [b]portrait [/b]outfit each season.

All M/F Marriable characters currently included [/center][center][/center] ﻿_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

[center][b]Recommended Mods[/b]:

Highly Reccommended! - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Stardewvalley Anime Mods﻿[/url] by  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/50885611]ohodavi[/url]
If you want anime portraits for other characters.
(tested and should not overwrite)

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url]
For seasonal character [b]sprites[/b]
([b][u]Delete the "portraits" folder in this mod or it will try to overwrite[/u][/b])

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3205]Wizard to Witch CP Version of CreepyKat[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/49761341]lineyakitty[/url]
(set "Witch" in config)[/center] ﻿_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

[b] Statement:[/b][/center]
[center]I have been using a personally modified SVO for years now but it came to my attention that there are no working Seasonal Anime mods on the nexus so I set out to right that wrong instead of hording it all for myself. Unfortunately my personal mod contained a massive amount of content from mods that had their rights revoked here on the nexus so I couldn't simply upload what I had. Instead I decided to build one from scratch! and a couple hundred hours of work later creating all new portraits/script and were finally here.

[url=https://www.buymeacoffee.com/RevanGrad]buymeacoffee[/url]﻿[/center] ﻿_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
﻿[center][b]Bugs:[/b]
NONE =)
If you find a portrait default to vanilla please post Who, where, when in the bug section.
(Abagail, hospital/Abagail, Flower festival, Etc.)﻿[/center]
         ﻿﻿_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

[b][center]To make your own portraits:[/center][/b]

[center]The script is already set to add all vanilla characters[b]. [/b]To add SVE you would have to add  "Target": "Portraits/name," to the //Seasonal section of the script.
simply download a portrait - Copy x paste so you have 4 of them (5 for female maternity) name them:[/center]
[center]Name_Fall.png
Name_spring.png
Name_summer.png
Name_winter.png
Name_maternity.png[/center]
[center]Put them all in folder #name - Put said folder into "Portraits" folder next to the others. ([CP] Seasonal Anime Characters III\assets\Portraits\name)[/center]
